title: Beyond: Two Souls
notes: Two short dxmt sessions today (~1 min and ~3 min, about 4 min total) to confirm the game launches and renders after the black-screen regression. Main menu and 3D scene both render normally under dxmt, no black screen. No frame rate recorded this time — the Metal HUD was on but I did not read it during play, so please treat the performance side as untested. How it went sideways, in case it helps the next person: the game ran fine on this same Mac the day before. It went black the next day after the environment's engine moved from x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r19 to x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r21 and its renderer from dxmt to dxvk. Launching from the Steam client window picks up the environment's current renderer, so that launch path inherited DXVK and died; launching from Highball's own library with the per-game override to dxmt works.
issues: Under DXVK the game shows a black screen with no error dialog: the D3D11 → Vulkan → MoltenVK path dies with `Lost VkDevice` / `VK_ERROR_DEVICE_LOST` and Metal `Internal Error (0000010d)`. The `VK_ERROR_OUT_OF_DEVICE_MEMORY` printed in the same log is misleading — GPU memory was 345 MB used of 12124 MB available. Pinning the game to dxmt fixes it completely. Worth flagging for anyone reading: launching from the Steam client window uses whatever the environment's renderer happens to be at that moment, which is exactly how this regressed from working to black between two days without the game itself changing.
